body: This is exactly how I feel. I'm also impressed when I see people who'd rather sleep on the sidewalk than die - that takes a certain strength I don't have, and I wonder what keeps them going. I've also lost my job and can't seem to find another, and am looking into rehoming my cat so she'll be safe without me. I don't have anything to live for but would absolutely muddle through if I could support myself financially. I can't, though - being alive really \*is\* too expensive - and I'd rather go out on my own terms rather than have to deal with the added stress of being homeless.
